description: Source code for the TestResultView React component, which renders detailed views of individual test results, including errors, steps, screenshots, traces, videos, and attachments in a web-based test report interface.

methods.name: groupImageDiffs
methods.description: Groups image attachments into diff sets for display, matching expected, actual, diff, and previous images, and filtering complete sets.

methods.name: pickDiffForError
methods.description: Selects the relevant image diff for a given error message if related to screenshot comparison.
